newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha falls with futures, supply limited.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha falls with futures, supply limited.

text.p: NWE naphtha was weaker on Monday as futures eased, traders said.
Bids and offers were heard at differing levels. One trader was heard to be prepared to pay for pipeline quality at $207 cif NWE.
But other players said this was above market, considering that a Skikda cargo had traded at $208.50 cif on Friday and crude futures had fallen by over three percent since then.
A quotes-related offer for full-range material was heard at cif high +$2.50-$3 cif NWE, but no business was heard done.
